articles.summary: Big Four valued NewGen’s planned UAE cell-sorting entity at US$19M as of May 31. Nadeem Malik will lead commercialization across the GCC.
articles.title: NewGen’s Advanced Cytometry Platform Poised for Major UAE/GCC Expansion with Big Four Valuation of US$19 Million

articles.summary: NewGen invested $10M in K25.ai’s Pre-A for an approximate 10% stake; a roughly $10M unrealized gain is expected to be booked in 2026.
articles.title: NewGen’s Strategic Pre-A Investment in K25.ai Doubles in Value as K25.ai’s Valuation Reaches US$200 Million
